title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cobie Durant (hamstring) works on rehab field during practice Monday
items.desc: Cobie Durant was working on the side field during practice on Monday.
items.impact: Durant remains week-to-week working his way back from a hamstring injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DeMarvion Overshown (hamstring) goes through individual drills Monday
items.desc: DeMarvion Overshown went through individual drills in practice on Monday.
items.impact: Overshown did the same in practice last Friday. He could have a chance at returning for Sunday's game against the Packers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. (illness) practices Monday
items.desc: Joey Porter Jr. was able to practice on Monday.
items.impact: Porter was ruled out late ahead of last Thursday's game against the Buccaneers. His presence in practice to start the week is a good sign for his status heading into Sunday's game against the Packers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Guyton (back) at practice Monday
items.desc: Tyler Guyton took part in practice on Monday.
items.impact: Guyton suffered a back injury in last Thursday's game against the Buccaneers. He was reported to not be dealing with a serious injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DaRon Bland not at start of practice Monday
items.desc: Cowboys CB DaRon Bland was not at the portion of Monday's practice open to reporters.
items.impact: It is unclear what the reason is for Bland's absence. He will need to be monitored on the injury report this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalen Coker (quad) 'on track' to return in Week 6
items.desc: Panthers head coach Dave Canales said Jalen Coker is "on track" to return for Week 6 against the Eagles.
items.impact: Canales added that Coker has a couple of big days of practice ahead of him this week. He'll need to be monitored in practice the next few days.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Carson Schwesinger (ankle) considered day-to-day
items.desc: Browns head coach Todd Monken called Carson Schwesinger day-to-day.
items.impact: Schwesinger is dealing with a Grade 1 ankle sprain. His status is uncertain heading into Week 6.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: T.J. Hockenson placed in concussion protocol
items.desc: The Vikings placed TE T.J. Hockenson in concussion protocol.
items.impact: Hockenson left Sunday's game early against the Saints. His status heading into Week 6 is up in the air.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dylan Sampson (knee) could have practice window opened this week
items.desc: Browns head coach Todd Monken said they might open RB Dylan Sampson's practice window this week.
items.impact: Sampson has been on injured reserve with a knee injury. He'll have 21 days to be activated when he has his practice window opened.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Quinshon Judkins (ankle) considered day-to-day
items.desc: Browns coach Todd Monken said RB Quinshon Judkins is day to day after a "tweak" in his ankle.
items.impact: Judkins was seen in a walking boot following Sunday's game against the Jets. His status will need to be monitored in practice this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dre Greenlaw suspended one game
items.desc: The NFL has suspended Dre Greenlaw one game.
items.impact: Greenlaw was ejected from Sunday's game against the Seahawks after he headbutted Ernest Jones on the sideline. He will miss next Monday's game against the Commanders.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Micah Parsons (knee) not expected to return to practice this week
items.desc: The Packers are not anticipating that Micah Parsons will return to practice this week.
items.impact: Schefter notes that there's still uncertainty about exactly when Parsons will return from his knee injury. He is hopeful to return at some point in October.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Justin Watson signs with Chiefs practice squad
items.desc: The Chiefs signed WR Justin Watson to their practice squad
items.impact: Watson will add depth in the wide receiver room for Kansas City. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trevor Etienne expected to return from IR this week
items.desc: Panthers coach Dave Canales said he expects RB Trevor Etienne to return from injured reserve this week.
items.impact: Etienne opened the season on injured reserve. He will add depth in the Panthers backfield when he is fully healthy.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Taylor Moton (blood clot) to have practice window opened this week
items.desc: Panthers coach Dave Canales said the team will open the practice window of OL Taylor Moton this week.
items.impact: Moton was placed on the non-football injury list during training camp. He will have the next 21 days to officially be activated.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tershawn Wharton (neck) to return to practice this week
items.desc: Panthers coach Dave Canales said the team will open the practice window of Tershawn Wharton this week.
items.impact: Wharton has been sidelined since training camp. He will have the next 21 days to officially be activated.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) 'has a chance' to return in Week 6
items.desc: Panthers coach Dave Canales said LB Jaelan Phillips has a "chance" to play against the Eagles next Sunday.
items.impact: "He's a powerful and he's huge," Canales said. "He can really run. ... He's a problem for opponents." Phillips will need to be monitored throughout the week.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Woody Marks will 'carry the load' for Texans with Montgomery out
items.desc: Woody Marks will reportedly "carry the load" for the Texans with David Montgomery week-to-week with a groin injury.
items.impact: Marks had 19 touches on Sunday and he operated as the Texans lead back in 2025, so this is nothing new to him. He's not overly dynamic, despite the coachspeak, but he can get it done for fantasy thanks to volume. He's a low-end RB2, high-end RB3 with the backfield to himself.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: David Montgomery (groin) 'week-to-week' with groin injury
items.desc: David Montgomery (groin) has been labeled "week-to-week" with a groin injury.
items.impact: Montgomery will likely miss some time with the injury, giving Woody Marks a chance to step up once again as the leader of the Houston backfield. When Monty returns, his value will be iffy, as he wasn't performing all too well even when healthy aside from his Week 1 burst when he had three touchdowns.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) to be re-evaluated Monday
items.desc: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said the team will re-evaluate RB TreVeyon Henderson on Monday.
items.impact: Henderson left Sunday's game early against the Raiders with an ankle injury. His status will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cardinals D/ST dismal in blowout loss Sunday
items.desc: The Cardinals' D/ST logged three sacks and allowed 45 points in Sunday's blowout loss to the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Arizona's defense looked terrible on Sunday. They allowed Detroit to score 45 points over the course of the afternoon, and they weren't able to come away with any turnovers to help out their own offense. This unit should not be started moving forward, especially in a tough matchup against the Rams next week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chad Ryland misses kick in loss Sunday
items.desc: Chad Ryland went 3-for-3 on his extra-point attempts but missed his lone field-goal attempt in Sunday's 45-21 loss to the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Ryland struggled on Sunday. He was able to make all three of his attempted extra points on Sunday, but he missed his lone field-goal attempt, which left three points out on the field for Arizona. He isn't expected to be a good fantasy option at the position moving forward.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: A.J. Brown (ankle) could return to practice this week
items.desc: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said WR A.J. Brown has a chance to return to practice this week.
items.impact: Brown is eligible to return from injured reserve beginning this week. His status will need to be monitored over the next few days to see if he is designated to return to practice.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Will Campbell (knee) considered day-to-day
items.desc: Patriots coach Mike Vrabel said they'll take it "day-by-day" with Will Campbell.
items.impact: Campbell suffered a knee sprain in Sunday's game against the Raiders. His status will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Teagan Quitoriano scores twice in loss Sunday
items.desc: Teagan Quitoriano caught two passes for 15 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 45-21 loss to the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Quitoriano didn't see much work on Sunday with just two targets, but he was able to haul both of them in for touchdowns in this loss to the Lions. This was a good game for him, but he shouldn't be expected to see much work moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Elijah Higgins racks up 57 yards Sunday
items.desc: Elijah Higgins caught three passes for 57 yards in Sunday's 45-21 loss to the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Higgins looked good on Sunday, turning his three targets into three catches for 57 yards in Arizona's loss to the Lions on Sunday. He has flashed some potential over the course of the season so far and now will enjoy increased opportunities with Marvin Harrison Jr. now out of town for the Cardinals.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kendrick Bourne leads team in receiving Sunday
items.desc: Kendrick Bourne hauled in 5-of-8 targets for 70 yards in Sunday's 45-21 loss to the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Bourne was a bright spot for the Cardinals on Sunday. He led the team with 70 total receiving yards over the course of the game, although he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, so his fantasy total remained mediocre. He will continue to be a highly involved member of this passing game moving forward with Marvin Harrison Jr. now out of town for the Cardinals.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyler Allgeier quiet in loss Sunday
items.desc: Tyler Allgeier rushed the ball three times for seven yards and caught two passes for nine yards in Sunday's 45-21 loss to the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Allgeier wasn't able to do much on Sunday. He logged just 16 total yards on his five touches, and he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, which left him with a terrible fantasy total. He is unlikely to be fantasy relevant moving forward, besides being a handcuff option behind rookie Jeremiyah Love.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Trey McBride hauls in touchdown Sunday
items.desc: Trey McBride hauled in 9-of-10 targets for 66 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 45-21 loss to the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: The star tight end played well on Sunday. He was able to record 66 yards and a touchdown on his nine catches, which left him with a great fantasy total on the afternoon. He should continue to be great moving forward, even with Arizona not expected to win many games over the course of the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Michael Penix Jr. (ribs) to undergo MRI
items.desc: Michael Penix Jr. will undergo an MRI on Monday on his rib injury.
items.impact: Penix said he doesn't believe his injury will be a long-term issue. He left Sunday's game late against the Ravens after taking a hard hit. His status will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Michael Wilson underwhelming in loss Sunday
items.desc: Michael Wilson caught 4-of-7 targets for just 30 yards in Sunday's 45-21 loss to the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Wilson wasn't able to do much on Sunday, totaling just 30 yards on four catches in a loss to the Lions. He should be the team's clear-cut WR1 moving forward moving forward with Marvin Harrison Jr. now out of town, but he's still subject to having some stinker performances on a week-to-week basis.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Roman Wilson (finger) expected to miss multiple weeks
items.desc: Steelers WR Roman Wilson is expected to miss a "couple of weeks" after suffering a finger injury on Sunday against the Colts.
items.impact: Wilson is seeking a second opinion after he was originally diagnosed with a dislocated finger. With Michael Pittman Jr. on IR, rookie Germie Bernard will step into a bigger role alongside Pat Freiermuth.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jeremiyah Love disappoints in loss Sunday
items.desc: Jeremiyah Love rushed the ball 12 times for 22 yards and failed to catch a pass in Sunday's 45-21 loss to the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: The rookie had an extremely disappointing game on Sunday. He rushed for an inefficient 22 yards on 12 carries, and he wasn't able to catch a single pass over the course of the game, which left him with a terrible fantasy total. He didn't play much late in the game when Arizona fell behind, and it's worth keeping tabs on updates about his injury status and the team's plan for workload management heading into Week 6.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) to undergo MRI
items.desc: Deebo Samuel Sr. will have an MRI on Monday.
items.impact: Samuel left Sunday's game early against the Seahawks and was ruled out for the afternoon. There should be an update on his status this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Lamar Jackson (ankle) 'has some hope' to return in Week 6
items.desc: There is reportedly "some hope" Lamar Jackson will play in Week 6 against the Browns.
items.impact: Tyler Huntley led Baltimore to a win on Sunday in Week 5 over the Falcons. Jackson will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jacoby Brissett throws three touchdowns Sunday
items.desc: Jacoby Brissett completed 29-of-47 passing attempts for 292 yards, three touchdowns, and one interception in Sunday's 45-21 loss to the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: The Cardinals suffered a blowout loss at the hands of the Lions on Sunday, but Brissett was able to have a good game from a fantasy perspective. He threw for nearly 300 yards and three touchdowns over the course of the game and limited mistakes with just one turnover in this matchup. He is a worthwhile streaming options in favorable matchups moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Lions D/ST logs five sacks in win Sunday
items.desc: The Lions' D/ST logged five sacks and an interception while allowing 21 points in Sunday's win over the Arizona Cardinals.
items.impact: Detroit's defense did well on Sunday, holding Arizona's offense to 21 points and logging multiple big plays to help out their own offense. This unit has shown a lot of weakness through the first five weeks of the season, however, so they shouldn't be started in most leagues for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Will Shipley suffers partial tear of plantar fascia
items.desc: Eagles RB Will Shipley suffered a partial tear of his plantar fascia during Sunday's loss to the Jaguars.
items.impact: Shipley is likely to miss multiple weeks. With Tank Bigsby on IR and Saquon Barkley still week-to-week, it could be Dameon Pierce leading the backfield in Week 6 against the Panthers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jake Bates scores nine points in win Sunday
items.desc: Jake Bates went 6-for-6 on his extra-point attempts and made his lone field-goal attempt in Sunday's 45-21 win over the Arizona Cardinals.
items.impact: The veteran kicker had a good game on Sunday, knocking in all seven of his kicks in the team's blowout win over Arizona. He should continue to be a good fantasy option at the kicker position for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Sam LaPorta stellar in win Sunday
items.desc: Sam LaPorta caught five passes for 88 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 45-21 win over the Arizona Cardinals.
items.impact: LaPorta looked great again on Sunday, finishing as Detroit's leading receiver with 88 yards and a touchdown on five catches against the Cardinals. He has been playing very well and remains a must-start fantasy option for the time being.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Isaac TeSlaa held without a catch Sunday
items.desc: Isaac TeSlaa failed to catch either of his two targets in Sunday's 45-21 win over the Arizona Cardinals.
items.impact: TeSlaa had close to 100 yards last week, but he did not follow that up with a good performance in Week 5. He wasn't able to catch a single pass on Sunday, despite the fact that Detroit's offense was unstoppable in this win over the Cardinals. He is hard to trust from a fantasy perspective moving forward, as he is likely considered the fifth option on this offense at best.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jameson Williams scores twice in win Sunday
items.desc: Jameson Williams caught 2-of-4 targets for 47 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 45-21 win over the Arizona Cardinals.
items.impact: Williams only caught two passes on Sunday, but he was able to get into the end zone on both of them, which left him with a great fantasy total in this win over the Cardinals. He is expected to continue to be a boom-or-bust fantasy option on a week-to-week basis moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown racks up 69 yards Sunday
items.desc: Amon-Ra St. Brown caught 6-of-11 targets for 69 yards in Sunday's 45-21 win over the Arizona Cardinals.
items.impact: The star wideout had an okay game on Sunday. He racked up 69 yards in an easy win over the Cardinals, but he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, which left him with a mediocre fantasy total to his standards. He has had a great start to the season overall and should continue to be a high-end fantasy option moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jahmyr Gibbs dominant in win Sunday
items.desc: Jahmyr Gibbs rushed the ball 25 times for 151 yards and two touchdowns and caught five passes for 56 yards in Sunday's 45-21 win over the Arizona Cardinals.
items.impact: Gibbs had yet another dominant game on Sunday. He logged over 200 total yards and two touchdowns in an easy win over the Cardinals as he continues the historic pace that he has been producing at through the first five weeks of the season. There's no reason to think he will slow down anytime soon, so fantasy managers should continue to value him as a top-tier fantasy asset for as long as he remains healthy and on the field.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jared Goff scores four touchdowns in win Sunday
items.desc: Jared Goff completed 19-of-30 passing attempts for 271 yards and three touchdowns and added another in Sunday's 45-21 win over the Arizona Cardinals.
items.impact: Goff was able to lead the Lions to an easy win over the Cardinals on Sunday. He was very efficient over the course of the afternoon, racking up nearly 300 total yards and four touchdowns, which left him with a fantastic fantasy total. He projects to be a quality fantasy option again in a home matchup against the Packers next week.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Caleb Williams (hamstring) may return in Week 6
items.desc: Caleb Williams (hamstring) could be back for the Bears in Week 6.
items.impact: Williams worked through some practice drills before Sunday's blowout loss in Green Bay and is reportedly "close" to returning. If all continues to progress at practice this week, the third-year QB could be back at the helm of the Bears offense on Sunday in Atlanta.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Javon Hargrave (Achilles) out for the season
items.desc: Javon Hargrave (Achilles) will miss the rest of the season.
items.impact: As feared, Hargrave tore his Achilles tendon in Sunday's game. This is certainly a blow to the Packers' defensive-line depth. Chris McClellan and Jonathan Ford should see an uptick in snaps.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Packers D/ST wreaks havoc in Week 5 win
items.desc: The Packers D/ST registered four sacks while also forcing five turnovers (three interceptions, two fumble recoveries) in a 31-7 win over the Chicago Bears in Week 5.
items.impact: The defense took advantage of a Chicago offense forced into using Tyson Bagent and Case Keenum behind center, holding the offense to 246 offensive yards in the win. The unit will look to slow down an explosive Dallas Cowboys offense in Week 6.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Trey Smack struggles in Week 5
items.desc: Trey Smack converted one of his three field goal attempts as well as two of his three extra point attempts to finish with five points in the Packers' 31-7 win over the Chicago Bears in Week 5.
items.impact: Smack has struggled to convert consistently of late, missing kicks in two of the last three games. The kicker will look to get back on track in a Week 6 contest against the Dallas Cowboys.
